review_notes: I read the whole file. I then checked the shared notions it relies on. `TauCeti.lieAnnihilator` is the Lie subalgebra of elements killing one fixed vector. Mathlib has `LieModule.ker` (the elements killing the whole module) and `maxTrivSubmodule` (the vectors killed by all of L). Neither is a per-vector stabiliser, and a grep of Mathlib/Algebra/Lie for annihilator or stabilizer found no equivalent. `IsCartanWeightVector` is a joint eigenvector condition with integer weights on chosen Cartan operators inside an enveloping-algebra representation. Its own file already relates it to `Module.End.eigenspace`, so it complements Mathlib rather than competing with it. `IsHighestWeightVector`, `typeBWeightEquiv` and `spinWeight` are specific to this development. The remaining declarations in this file are theorems, so they fall outside the rubric. I found no avoidable competing definition in this file.
